name: Funereal Malediction
body:
School necromancy [curse]; Level antipaladin 3, bloodrager 4, cleric/oracle 3, lathspell 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 4, spiritualist 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration permanent
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You inflict a creature with a curse that makes them susceptible to dark magics of death. They take a -8 penalty on saves against death effects, energy drain, and any spell or effect that deals negative energy damage.
